headline: Popees Baby Care AGM: All resolutions passed
summary: Popees Baby Care India Ltd shareholders approved all four resolutions at the 38th AGM held on September 30, 2026, including auditor appointment and director re-election.

headline: Loans against FDs surge 43% to ₹2.04 lakh crore
summary: Loans against fixed deposits rose 43% to ₹2.04 lakh crore, with FCNR(B)-linked leverage cited as a key driver of the sharp increase in borrowing activity.

headline: Reliance Industries plans ₹1 lakh crore CBG investment
summary: Reliance Industries plans to invest ₹1 lakh crore in compressed biogas in Andhra Pradesh, with the initiative expected to create 3 lakh jobs in the state.

headline: Sikozy Realtors AGM: Borrowing limit set at ₹5 crore
summary: Sikozy Realtors shareholders approved a borrowing limit of ₹5 crore and adopted FY26 financials despite auditor's going concern warning.

headline: Drug panel rejects national cap on wholesale licences
summary: A drug panel has rejected the idea of a national cap on wholesale licences, instead calling for stricter monitoring at the state level to regulate drug distribution.

headline: Industries seek GST relief on input tax credit
summary: Pharma, EV, and other industries are seeking GST relief to unlock accumulated input tax credit, according to a newspaper report.

headline: SBI Research flags possible 25 bps repo rate hike
summary: SBI Research has flagged the possibility of the Reserve Bank of India raising the repo rate by 25 bps at the October Monetary Policy Committee meeting.

headline: MIAL plans to cut 265 weekly flight slots from Oct 26
summary: Mumbai International Airport plans to temporarily discontinue 265 weekly flight slots from October 26 as part of preparations for the redevelopment of Terminal 1.

headline: Indian coffee exports rise 25% to 2.42 lakh tonne in H1FY27
summary: India's coffee exports rose 25% to 2.42 lakh tonne in H1FY27, driven by strong global demand, benefiting exporters including CCL Products and Tata Consumer Products.

headline: Maharashtra FDA cancels Cipla unit's drug sale licence
summary: Maharashtra FDA has cancelled the drug sale licence of a Cipla unit over alleged violations, as reported by a newspaper. The development raises regulatory concerns for the pharma major.

headline: Jyothy Labs pauses acquisitions, eyes personal care
summary: Jyothy Laboratories has put acquisitions on hold and is shifting focus toward new product launches and the personal care segment, according to a newspaper report.
